# Antikvarijat Biblos

> Antikvarijat Biblos is an antiquarian bookshop and online store in Zagreb, Croatia, offering used, rare and collectible books, maps and historical views. The website is available in Croatian and English.

Antikvarijat Biblos is located at Palmotićeva 28, 10000 Zagreb. The physical shop is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 14:00. Product pages are the authoritative source for current price, condition and availability because the inventory changes frequently.

Croatian is the primary language and uses URLs without a language prefix. English pages use the `/en` prefix. Prefer the canonical URL and language version that matches the user's query.

## Primary Croatian pages

- [Naslovnica](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/): Pregled antikvarijata i aktualne ponude.
- [Knjige](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/knjige): Dostupne rabljene, rijetke i kolekcionarske knjige.
- [Zemljovidi i vedute](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/zemljovidi-i-vedute): Dostupni povijesni zemljovidi, karte i vedute.
- [Autori](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/autor): Pregled dostupnih knjiga prema autoru.
- [Nakladnici](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/nakladnik): Pregled dostupnih knjiga prema nakladniku.
- [Sniženja](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/snizenja): Trenutačno sniženi artikli.
- [Blog](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/blog): Članci o knjigama, piscima, bibliofiliji i kulturnoj baštini.
- [O nama](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/info/o-nama): Informacije o Antikvarijatu Biblos.
- [Otkup knjiga](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/otkup-knjiga): Upute i obrazac za ponudu knjiga i časopisa na otkup.
- [Česta pitanja](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/faq): Odgovori o kupnji, dostavi, plaćanju i uslugama.
- [Kontakt](https://www.antikvarijat-biblos.hr/kontakt): Adresa, radno vrijeme, telefon, e-mail i kontaktni obrazac.

## Notes

- Use individual product pages for citations about a book's author, publisher, year, binding, condition, price and stock.
- An item marked unavailable or out of stock cannot be assumed to be purchasable.
- Customer reviews shown on product pages are moderated and linked to verified purchases when the purchase can be confirmed.
- Contact details: info@antikvarijat-biblos.hr and +385 1 48 16 574.
